note: Triennial election of Newry No. 2 (County Armagh) Rural District Council, twenty-nine single-member divisions, 1958. Nominations 20 May 1958; two withdrawals (Ballybot, Killeen); six contests, polled Thursday 5 June 1958. No nomination for Moyra Castle, whose outgoing member was deemed re-elected. Labels as printed in the Newry Telegraph. No nomination; the outgoing member was deemed re-elected. Deemed re-elected (no nomination). Earlier transcription: McCann, was deemed re-elected (Newry Telegraph, 24 May 1958, p. 1).
